apply_updates: apply gradient updates to model parameters and return updated params tree
create_incremental_update: create polyak averaging of model parameters using exponential moving average with step size
build_periodic_update: build a slow target network copy updated every K steps for self-supervision or RL

review_incremental_update: review the polyak averaging function that computes step_size*new + (1-step_size)*old
